attributes.title: NASP 2027 Annual Convention
attributes.venue: Charlotte Convention Center & The Westin Charlotte
attributes.summary:
The National Association of School Psychologists holds its 2027 Annual Convention February 23 to 26, 2027, at the Charlotte Convention Center and The Westin Charlotte. NASP lists more than 1,200 sessions. A Charlotte Express virtual package covers the general session, eight documented sessions and selected posters.

Full registration costs $279 for members, $114 for graduate students and $529 for non-members through November 18, 2026. Prices then rise to $299, $124 and $549 until January 6, 2027, and to $329, $134 and $569 after that and on site. Daily registration ($199 member, $310 non-member) opens after January 6. The virtual package costs $159 or $385 until January 6.

NASP is approved by the APA to sponsor CE for psychologists, but only Documented Sessions (1.25 hours each, $15–$25 extra) and Workshops (3 or 6 hours, $115–$175) carry NASP/APA-approved CPD. The virtual package offers up to 10.25 hours. Other sessions may count as Category A CPD toward NCSP renewal.
